gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Tourney draws every letter with a marker-nib stroke that ignores direction, stretched wide and bulky into something sporty and loud. It hits hardest as a headline, while Noto Sans Marchen quietly handles the reading.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Tourney's bulky little letters all share one unbroken line width, stretched out with wide tracking for a loud, athletic look. Noto Sans Medefaidrin, a sans-serif with high-rising lowercase, keeps paragraphs crisp and open.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Noto Sans Mende Kikakui reads openly, with daylight through every curve and lowercase that stands high against its capitals. Tourney's plotter-pen strokes, wide and chunky, give it a loud partner.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mono: Tourney cuts every stroke to a single width, with wide tracking and oversized small letters that look sporty and loud. Noto Sans Mono spaces its sturdy, tall-standing letters generously, so nothing bumps, and the heading earns its keep big and brief.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro builds dense, tall-feeling words with wide entrances into each letter, giving text a modern, businesslike look. Tourney's pipe-cleaner strokes are best shouted large, while Mro simply carries the reading.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Bold and athletic Tourney comes first, with crossbars as fat as its stems and wide tracking, over a thick strip of text. Noto Sans Myanmar feels clean and welcoming beside it, like a loud friend sitting next to a steady one.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Noto Sans Nabataean stands its lowercase almost as high as its capitals, with wide-open s curves that look professional. And Tourney, drawn like a round-tipped pen, is best at bold display while Nabataean does the quiet reading.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-newa: Noto Sans Newa leaves the mouth of its lowercase e clearly open, with generous bowls and counters that feel modern. Newa goes down easily over a long passage, while Tourney's drafting-pen line stays loud above it.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Tourney's pencil-like line never presses harder, so every wide, bulky letter keeps the same weight. Noto Sans Old Hungarian, a sans-serif with big open counters, would hold up where a shrunken Tourney would start to feel cramped.
gen-tourney-gf-noto-sans-old-north-arabi: Tourney's ballpoint-like line has no pressure variation, and its wide tracking and oversized small letters feel bold and sporty. But Noto Sans Old North Arabian makes a dense, high band of text with outward-pointing terminals, a friendly counterweight.
